description: This file appears to be a shell script used in the OpenWrt project, specifically for device diagnostics and LED status management. It contains functions to identify and set the state of LEDs based on system status, utilizing external functions and interacting with system files.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and sets the path to the status LED device based on system LED names.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the argument provided, corresponding to different system statuses.
